Put the selected manual-native TA code in layout_code for schema compatibility. A missing fact is layout-blocking only when it prevents choosing among mutually exclusive primary Typical Applications. If the best-matching TA itself states a conditional augmentation for a higher, lower, or otherwise unknown condition, keep that TA as primary and preserve the unresolved condition for later requirement applicability instead of demoting the whole TA. Return indeterminate only when the primary TA itself cannot be selected; list missing fields and do not guess. The complete unranked Typical Application title catalogue below is a navigation aid from the frozen manual, not a selected answer. Compare all potentially matching titles, retrieve their source notes before choosing, and do not choose a broader layout without examining a title that more specifically describes the traffic operation. You must call search_manual at least once before returning JSON.
